consts.name: ddcQuasiPlaneCount
consts.comment: the four positive quasi-planes between the Positive Material and the majors: Lightning (Air), Radiance (Fire), Minerals (Earth), Steam (Water) - the most changing and dynamic of the inner planes, their Positive borders ebbing and flowing like tides.

consts.name: ddcLightningStrikePctL
consts.comment: the lightning strike chances per round: 5% size S, 10% size M, 20% size L; a bolt deals 1d8 of d10s (1-80) halved by a save vs. spell; protection from lightning gives safety.

consts.name: ddcLightningDeafTurns
consts.comment: the elemental thunder: normal speech impossible, a turn unprotected deafens for 2d4x10 (264) turns, longer stays risk permanent deafness (Con check; heal cures) - wax or putty ear plugs negate; the harm stops at the Border Ethereal but the noise still drowns speech there.

consts.name: ddcMineralsMoveDamageDie
consts.comment: the Minerals movement damage: each round of movement deals 1d4 plus the traveler's AC; Earth/Minerals natives and AC below -4 are unharmed; Dex bonuses do not count, magic armor is two planes reduced.

consts.name: ddcQuasiEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers in the positive quasi-planes have a 1-in-10 chance of an encounter (the lightning bolts and crystal cuts excluded); roll: 1-20 positive energy phenomenon, 21-30 elemental pocket, 31-00 creature encounter.

consts.name: ddcWallAdvanceDieSides
consts.comment: the positive energy intrusion: a wall of advancing white brilliance moving 3d6 inches per round for 2d10 turns - full Positive Material immersion effects, the border lost after 1d4 rounds in the wall.

consts.name: ddcPocketConvertPct
consts.comment: the only pockets in a quasi-plane are of its related major plane (entering = entering that plane, 30% native lair chance); pockets survive energy walls by conversion - carried at the front, left behind at the retreat.

consts.name: ddcGemSurviveDenom
consts.comment: the Minerals gem economy: only one in 100 stones survives return to a gravity plane; survivors worth 1,000 gp base; removing more than ~100 stones alarms the natives - the guides abandon the greedy halfway through the plane.

consts.name: ddcPetrifyStonePct
consts.comment: the Minerals fossilization: non-inner natives save vs. spell each true turn (inner non-natives once per subjective day); failure petrifies instantly - 80% stone (stone to flesh reverses), 20% crystal/gold-veined granite (only a full wish); petrification protection does not help; brought to gravity, 99% crumble to dust.

bools.name: ddcRadianceBlindRule
bools.comment: the Radiance survival: Fire's burning and breathing dangers, plus unprotected eyes save vs. death or be permanently blinded (infravision -2 to the save, both visions -4); darkness spells or smoked lenses (fragile, 1-in-4 knocked off when hit) permit sight; Border viewers unharmed but formless to the eye.

bools.name: ddcSteamMuggyRule
bools.comment: the Steam survival: not hot but muggy - movement slowed by water gathering in the lungs (water breathing negates), vision limited to 10d6 yards of thick fog; the least hostile positive quasi-plane.

bools.name: ddcLightningNativeImmunity
bools.comment: the native immunities: Lightning natives immune to electrical attacks, resisting weather and wind as Air creatures; Radiance natives immune to fire, heat and light attacks, vulnerable to water as fire elementals, driven off by darkness; Minerals natives pass through earth, immune to solid-affecting spells; Steam natives unaffected by air, water and heat magic.

bools.name: ddcGuidePriceDoubled
bools.comment: quasi-elemental guides: hyperactive and erratic, the first task is slowing them to bargain; the same bribes as their elemental cousins but the price is ALWAYS at least doubled; no conception of haggling - refuse the terms and they leave (or attack if evil and stronger).

bools.name: ddcNoQuasiArchoment
bools.comment: no known archoments or true rulers in the positive quasi-planes - the inhabitants too frantically busy for hierarchy; the ring of great towers (blue flame, lead, solidified clouds, ice) extends into the Positive on thin peninsulas, origin unknown, home to exiled Powers and researchers.
